lines.text: Many learners say: She is married with a doctor.
Better: She is married to a doctor.
To! He is married to my sister.

data.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
data.right: She is married to a doctor.

native.tip: हिंदी में “से शादी” सुनकर with बोल देते हैं; अंग्रेज़ी में “married to” कहें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी कहते हैं “She is married with a doctor”? 😉 अंग्रेज़ी में “She is married to a doctor” सही है, क्योंकि married के बाद to आता है, with नहीं। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “to”। with की जगह to बोलें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: From the Hindi “se shaadi” people say with; in English say “married to”.
en.caption: Do you say “She is married with a doctor”? 😉 In English “She is married to a doctor” is right, because married takes to, not with. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
